mechanism: Tobramycin (aminoglycoside) can cause nephrotoxicity and ototoxicity, potentially affecting pramipexole renal clearance and increasing CNS dopaminergic effects; pramipexole may also mask symptoms of tobramycin-induced vestibular toxicity through CNS effects.
action: Monitor renal function closely during concurrent use; ensure adequate hydration; assess for signs of vestibular dysfunction and adjust pramipexole dosing if renal impairment develops.
